The '''Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]]-owned and-operated corporation that manufactured vehicles specifically for Geonosian use.

==History==
The company was responsible for designing and manufacturing [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]], and the [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighters]] used by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and her henchmen. Besides fighter-sized craft, it was capable of producing larger capital vessels such as the [[Geonosian corvette]] and the [[Geonosian dreadnaught]].
[[File:SolarSailer-CW6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A ''Punworcca 116''-class solar sailer]]

Huppla Pasa Tisc was virtually unknown outside the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]] since its products relied on the Geonosians' unique physiology and senses, making them useless to all other [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Geonosians were also staunchly isolationist. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and produced vehicles for them.
